sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Description > Description
sections.content: The Personal Loan Against Mortgage Program provides secured personal financing backed by a first-degree mortgage on real estate. It is designed for various customer segments, offering higher loan amounts and more flexible terms due to the collateralized nature of the facility.

content_blocks.text: The Personal Loan Against Mortgage Program provides secured personal financing backed by a first-degree mortgage on real estate. It is designed for various customer segments, offering higher loan amounts and more flexible terms due to the collateralized nature of the facility.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 1. Target Segments
sections.content: The program is available for the following categories: • Public sector employees, military and Jordan public security , and customs. • Retirees. • Private sector employees. • Business owners and self-employed professionals. • Jordanian expatriates.

items: Public sector employees, military and Jordan public security , and customs.

sections.content: • Minimum age: 21 years. • Maximum age at application: 65 years. • The customer’s age must not exceed 75 years at the end of the loan tenor.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 11. Maximum Loan Amount
sections.content: By Customer Segment • Up to 50 times salary for Regular segment. • Up to 60 times income for Upper Regular , select and Private banking segments. • Maximum loan cap: JOD 250,000.

content_blocks.label: Items
items: Up to 50 times salary for Regular segment.
Up to 60 times income for Upper Regular , select and Private banking segments.
Maximum loan cap: JOD 250,000.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 12. Financing Ratio
sections.content: • Up to 70% for ready properties (residential/commercial). • Up to 50% for land within zoning areas. • Outside zoning land is not eligible for financing.

content_blocks.label: 12. Financing Ratio
items: Up to 70% for ready properties (residential/commercial).
Up to 50% for land within zoning areas.
Outside zoning land is not eligible for financing.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 13. Debt Burden Ratio
sections.content: • Regular and Upper Regular Segments: 50% of total obligations. • Select and Private Banking segments: 55% total obligations (50% loans + 5% credit cards).

content_blocks.label: 13. Debt Burden Ratio
items: Regular and Upper Regular Segments: 50% of total obligations.
Select and Private Banking segments: 55% total obligations (50% loans + 5% credit cards).

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 14. Property Valuation
sections.content: • One valuation for properties up to JOD 100,000. • Two valuations for properties above JOD 100,000: o Average of valuations is taken. o If variance exceeds 20%, the lower valuation is used. • Unlicensed rooftops/gardens may be included if approved by the Real Estate Department.

content_blocks.label: 14. Property Valuation
items: One valuation for properties up to JOD 100,000.
Two valuations for properties above JOD 100,000: o Average of valuations is taken. o If variance exceeds 20%, the lower valuation is used.
Unlicensed rooftops/gardens may be included if approved by the Real Estate Department.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 15. Property Documents Required
sections.content: • Recent title deed (issued within last 3 months) showing all property details. • Land map. • Zoning map. • Subdivision statement or occupancy permit.

content_blocks.label: 15. Property Documents Required
items: Recent title deed (issued within last 3 months) showing all property details.
Land map.
Zoning map.
Subdivision statement or occupancy permit.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 16. Income Verification Documents > Salaried Customers
sections.content: o A salary certificate showing the gross salary and net salary transferred to the bank if the salary has been fixed for the last 3 months, or salary slips for the last 3 months showing the gross salary, net salary, and deductions applicable to the customer (6 slips in case of incentives or overtime payments). o Commitment letter and end-of-service transfer undertaking addressed to the bank. o Certified bank statement for the last 6 months. o Social Security Statement for employees of TML companies if the employment period is less than 24 months, excluding Select + PB segments. o Social Security statement for all employees of Non TML companies, regardless of the employment period .

content_blocks.label: Salaried Customers
items: A salary certificate showing the gross salary and net salary transferred to the bank if the salary has been fixed for the last 3 months, or salary slips for the last 3 months showing the gross salary, net salary, and deductions applicable to the customer (6 slips in case of incentives or overtime payments).
Commitment letter and end-of-service transfer undertaking addressed to the bank.
Certified bank statement for the last 6 months.
Social Security Statement for employees of TML companies if the employment period is less than 24 months, excluding Select + PB segments.
Social Security statement for all employees of Non TML companies, regardless of the employment period .

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 16. Income Verification Documents > Business Owners
sections.content: o Commercial registration. o Valid professional license. o Bank statement for the last 6 months.

content_blocks.label: Business Owners
items: Commercial registration.
Valid professional license.
Bank statement for the last 6 months.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 16. Income Verification Documents > Professionals
sections.content: o Professional practice license. o Bank statement for the last 6 months.

content_blocks.label: Professionals
items: Professional practice license.
Bank statement for the last 6 months.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 16. Income Verification Documents > Jordanian Expatriates
sections.content: o Salary Transfer Customers : Salary certificate and salary slip for the last 3 months + Bank statement for the last 6 months. o Business owners: Recent commercial registration + Financial statements for the last two years. o Credit report from the country of residence. o QR code authentication may replace official attestation where available. o Otherwise, salary certificates and commercial registrations must be certified by the relevant authorities and the Jordanian embassy. o IRS tax statement is required for expatriates residing in Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom.

content_blocks.label: Jordanian Expatriates
items: Salary Transfer Customers : Salary certificate and salary slip for the last 3 months + Bank statement for the last 6 months.
Business owners: Recent commercial registration + Financial statements for the last two years.
Credit report from the country of residence.
QR code authentication may replace official attestation where available.
Otherwise, salary certificates and commercial registrations must be certified by the relevant authorities and the Jordanian embassy.
IRS tax statement is required for expatriates residing in Canada, the United States, and the United Kingdom.

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 17. Credit Approval Validity & Grace Period
sections.content: • Credit approval validity: 45 days. • Grace period: up to 90 days (interest-free).

content_blocks.label: 17. Credit Approval Validity & Grace Period
items: Credit approval validity: 45 days.
Grace period: up to 90 days (interest-free).

sections.section_title: PL against mortgage > Terms and Conditions > 18. General Notes
sections.content: • This product is secured by real estate mortgage, which allows higher eligibility compared to unsecured personal loans. • Only one loan is allowed per customer under this program. • Financing conditions depend on customer segment and property type.

content_blocks.label: 18. General Notes
items: This product is secured by real estate mortgage, which allows higher eligibility compared to unsecured personal loans.
Only one loan is allowed per customer under this program.
Financing conditions depend on customer segment and property type.
